narrative_purpose: The Pandora payload of the magnetic sense: a banshee flies a clean confident arc through the floating mountains while the magnetic field twists violently around the peaks and a distant human aircraft trails failing sparks — the contrast that proves the animal runs a sense the machines cannot.
subject: A mountain banshee banking in flight through a canyon between two floating Hallelujah Mountains, magnetic field lines drawn as glowing contour-ribbons twisting and knotting around the peaks; in the far distance a small human aircraft tilts awkwardly, faint red sparks trailing from its instruments, while the banshee holds a smooth assured curve through the same chaotic field.
scene: High among the suspended mountains wreathed in cloud and glowing field-lines, deep sky falling away below into teal haze.
camera: A wide dramatic aerial three-quarter view following the banshee through the field-laced canyon, the failing aircraft small and far.
light: Cool ambient daylight-through-haze on the peaks, the magnetic field-lines self-glowing magenta-cyan; the banshee rim-lit, the distant aircraft marked by a few failing warm sparks.
palette: Void-indigo and ocean-teal sky, magenta and Pandora-cyan field-ribbons, the banshee in teal with a scarce warm spark from the distant machine.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted, atmospheric.
detail_level: Crisp on the banshee and the nearest field-lines; mountains and aircraft dissolving into haze.
composition: The banshee on a confident diagonal through the lower-third, field-lines spiralling around the peaks above, the tiny struggling aircraft in the far upper corner for contrast, deep negative space of haze.
consistency_notes: Same banshee build and cool Pandora palette as the direhorse-and-banshee chapter; floating mountains consistent with the superconductor chapter; field-lines self-luminous, not a digital HUD.
